title: How Inclusively do LMs Perceive Social and Moral Norms?

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Absolute Distance Alignment Metric (ADA-Met) to compare LM predictions on rules-of-thumb with the aggregated ordinal responses of human annotators grouped by age brackets.
Measuring the alignment between LM predictions on moral and social rules-of-thumb and the aggregated responses of human annotators grouped by income levels and educational attainment using ADA-Met.
Calculating the Absolute Distance Alignment Metric (ADA-Met) to compare LM predictions on rules-of-thumb with the aggregated responses of male versus female human annotators.
Evaluating LM alignment with human annotators grouped by marital status and parental status (whether they have children) using the Absolute Distance Alignment Metric (ADA-Met).
